title: Cloud backup
pitch: Keep a copy of your walks, runs and rides on the CityTurfer server, so a new phone never means starting your turf again.
privacy: Your routes are stored on our server in the EU. Turning this off deletes that copy; nothing on this phone.
offConfirmText: The copy of your activities on our server will be deleted. Everything stays on this phone, and you can turn backup on again any time.
healthNote: Off: workouts imported from Apple Health stay on this phone (and leave the server).
refused: {count, plural, one {# activity can’t be backed up (too long or unreadable).} other {# activities can’t be backed up (too long or unreadable).}}
progress: Backed up {backedUp} of {total, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}}
progressLastRun: Backed up {backedUp} of {total, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}} · last run {lastRun}

restore.title: Welcome back
restore.offer: {count, plural, one {Your backup holds # activity that isn’t on this phone. Bring it over and your turf comes back with it. Nothing here is replaced.} other {Your backup holds # activities that aren’t on this phone. Bring them over and your turf comes back with them. Nothing here is replaced.}}
restore.resume: Restoring your backup stopped at {done} of {total} activities. Carry on where it left off.
restore.actionNote: Brings over anything in your backup that isn’t on this phone. Nothing here is replaced or doubled.
restore.backupOff: Cloud backup is off on this phone. Turn it on to keep new activities safe too.
restore.healthOff: Apple Health workouts aren’t backed up from this phone. You can turn that on in Info › Cloud backup.
restore.restoredSkipped: Restored {restored}. {skipped} couldn’t be read and stayed on the server.
restore.nothingToRestore: This phone already has everything in your backup.
restore.restored: Restored {count, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}}.
restore.signInFirst: Sign in with your email to restore your backup.
restore.linkFirst: To restore, first confirm your email with a code in Info › Cloud backup.

paused.recording: Finish your recording first. Restoring carries on afterwards.
paused.background: Restoring paused while CityTurfer was in the background. Tap Restore to carry on.
paused.offline: No connection right now. Tap Restore when you’re online; it carries on where it stopped.
paused.server: The server had a hiccup. Tap Restore to try again.
paused.auth: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again to restore.

link.offer: To back up this profile, confirm {email} with a code we’ll email there.
link.mailboxNote: Anyone who can read that inbox can sign in and see this backup.
link.sent: We emailed a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
link.sentRecently: We emailed a code to {email} recently. Enter the latest one; each code works for 10 minutes.
link.resendIn: {count, plural, one {Send a new code in # second} other {Send a new code in # seconds}}
link.linked: Code accepted. This profile is now linked to the account for {email}.
link.stayedOff: Backup stays off. The server’s copy is deleted. Everything stays on this phone.
link.stayedOffPending: Backup stays off. The server’s copy is deleted the next time this phone is online. Everything stays on this phone.
link.newAccount: This email now has a new CityTurfer account, and backup for it is off. Tap Turn on backup to start.
